title: 多年失败产品后，他终于做到月入11万
carouselChartTitle: 多年失败产品后，他终于做到月入11万
author: 阿星
content:
**16岁做软件工程师，他说：每天工作16小时是我唯一的原因**

Nic来自Ukraine。16岁开始做software engineer。

Eventually realized didn't really want grow in engineering role。Indie hacking seemed like so much more fun。

Also seemed like much easier way earn money。Oh boy，was wrong。

2022年开始indie hacking，同时full-time job。Very few applicable skills。Shy introvert。No big ideas。Didn't know any founders。Just knew how to code，didn't want to stop。

Spent 1.5年figuring it out with failed product after failed product。

Then，launch了一个blog，grew到about $500月收入。While working on that blog，realized Pinterest是drive traffic to websites的好channel。Created tool automate process，became BlogToPin。

Launch三周后，quit job。No revenue，但about a year runway，decide give it a try。

Now ~15k MRR（约11万人民币），去年from $10k增长。

Recently also building email marketing tool for SaaS called Sequenzy。六个月前launch，现在1k MRR。

## 二、

BlogToPin initial version用一两个月build。但truth是took a while before working well——very ambitious problem solve。Probably another six months improve和get users。

Mostly designed by vibe coding和copy-pasting from Tailwind UI。技术栈：Next.js + Drizzle。还用separate Express.js server handle long-running tasks——pin creation、website processing、pin scheduling、pin uploading。

- NextJS
- Drizzle
- tRPC
- shadcn
- Express
- BullMQ（for jobs）
- MySQL on PlanetScale（for data）

It's simple，but AI good at it。

## 三、

Sell monthly和annual subscriptions at $39、$79、$179。大部分人在cheapest plan。Approximately 30% choose annual。

**Churn是目前最大issue。** 人们starting out时不consider，但churn limits ceiling。BlogToPin's churn ~10-15%，意味着need acquire extra $2k MRR each month just stay even。That's a lot。

Launch Sequenzy时，top priority是choosing infrastructure niche——因为inherently low churn。

## 四、

Growth mostly because built good product。当然，spread the word everywhere can，stick with easiest channels。

**SEO content：** Target "Pinterest marketing tool"，use that everywhere on website。Also create listicles和do outreach for backlinks。

**Encouraging referrals：** Give generous 30% lifetime commission。Very good rate，lots of people happy with app，so promote it。

**YouTube：** Focus on SEO-optimized keywords like "how to not get banned"、"how to create AI pins"等。Gets few views here and there，compounds over time。

**Replying on reddit：** Very slow、manual thing。Don't use tool，just try be genuinely helpful。But reddit getting harder and harder。Mods banning people all the time。Tricky。

**Influencer marketing：** Reached out to all influencers in niche——two people replied。Only one brought lot of customers。Numbers game。But importantly，have to be super open-minded、adjust product、try make it genuinely useful for influencer。

SEO probably contributes 50%，great because basically works on autopilot。

## 五、

Made lot of dumb mistakes。Probably made every single mistake possible。

Product is where is for only one reason：**Work 16 hours per day。**

It's that simple。Outwork every competitor。

Because work so much，can run more experiments、talk to more customers、ultimately make better product。That compounds。

## 六、

建议：

**Get ready for a long haul。**

**Ship fast。**

**Iterate。**

**Don't quit。**

真的。Just don't stop。Whenever unsure what to do next，do something。Improve product、do marketing、talk to customers。Anything。

## 写在最后

Nic的故事告诉我们——

**Success doesn't require genius。It requires persistence and work ethic。**

1.5年失败产品。然后breakthrough。

His secret？**16 hours a day。Outworking competition。**

这不是glamorous的建议。不是growth hacks或secret tactics。就是hard work。

But he's also smart about it——
- Focus on low-churn niches for new products
- 30% lifetime commission for referrals（generous）
- SEO works on autopilot once set up
- Be genuinely helpful on Reddit（even if slow）

Goal：BlogToPin到$20-30k MRR，Sequenzy到$100k MRR。

他会做到的。Because he doesn't quit。

*原文来自Indie Hackers，由AI翻译并改写*
